notes.title: Working On a flying Game mode!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am working on a flying game mode for this game. The goal is to stay alive as long as you can while defending yourself from a horde of enemies.
This is a little preview, let me know what you think. 

 [previewyoutube=ubsTPJYTXSc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dex Survival is released on Oct 28th 2020 with 15% discount!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
We are finally here!
Tomorrow will be the launching day for our first game. We're launching the game with a 15% discount and please make sure to share it with your friend.

The game will be launching in early access and we have done our best to test it. We hope it will run smoothly on your Pc.  
Please consider that the game may have some issues, so feel free to let us know if you are having problems with the game.

This is the first game of our studio so please don't hesitate to give your feedback.
We hope you have a lot of fun playing our game.

Best regards!
Quiskeya Studio
